title: GVA head-reconstruction Mirror code bank
hypothesis: At fixed training tokens and matched native GVA architecture, a structured head-m bank reduces all inference reconstruction state by >=15% while keeping NLL within +0.02 nats/token and P95 decode latency <=1.10 native GVA.
physical_object: one GVA grouped-V and decoupled positional-key cache with shared reconstruction basis
mirror_coordinate: head/role m selecting a compact content-key reconstruction map
logical_multiplicity: logical query-head key functions over the same grouped cached V stream
closest_controls: native GVA full M_h / GVA low-rank M_h / GQA / MLA

requirements.native: Reproduce a 2-group 4-head tiny GVA block with separate position key and full per-head matrix M_h, plus GQA/MLA and low-rank GVA map controls. If GVA author kernels/checkpoint unavailable, report proxy reproduction and do not claim paper speedups.
requirements.insertion: Parameterize content key reconstruction M_h(m)=M_shared+sum_i m_hi B_i with small head m; use q'=q M_h(m)^T at inference instead of materializing K. The positional RoPE key stays separate. Include shared basis, m vectors and query-side transform compute.
requirements.method: Use shape-conformant tensors V_cache[b,t,g,dv], q[b,t,h,dk], M_h[dv,dk]. Compute scores both explicitly with reconstructed content keys and via absorbed query; their max difference in float64 must be <1e-9 on a deterministic toy fixture. Sweep k=2,4,8 against full M and LoRA rank-matched maps. Verify GVA content/position channels never get incorrectly fused.
requirements.fixture: Synthetic attention retrieval (copy and multi-query matching) with length 64/128, d_model=64, H=4, grouped V G=2, position channel=16, fixed optimizer steps=2000 per model and identical training examples; a tiny word-level LM lane is secondary and must be labeled.
requirements.hardware: Stage 1 CPU float64 exact algebra and PyTorch float32 8M-style tiny LM; Stage 2 optional CUDA GPU with batch 1 and 8, context length 128 and 512, warmup and 100 repeated isolated steps, report GPU type/clock.

development.allowed: select code dimension, LR, stop condition only

resources.compute: training examples and updates, FLOPs or MACs, CPU/GPU P50/P95 with batch/dtype/hardware
resources.quality: NLL/retrieval accuracy, serialized basis+head m bytes, physical cache scalars/bytes and allocator stats, attention score error, FLOPs/step, isolated CPU P50/P95 and optional GPU decode.

gates.PASS: All 5 fresh seeds <=+0.02 nats/token vs matched native full-GVA, >=15% reconstruction-state bytes saved (not double count baseline cache), and P95 decode <=1.10 GVA. End-to-end claims require a real decode kernel, not eager PyTorch alone.
gates.FAIL: Byte-near native GVA low-rank control matches or beats quality/runtime, nonmatching attention scores, or basis+code overhead erases reconstruction savings.
gates.UNCERTAIN: Missing strong control, uncertain precision, insufficient heldout data, unmeasured runtime or CI overlap

alternative: Native full M can be too cheap relative to basis metadata; GVA baseline already eliminates persistent content-key cache, leaving little marginal Mirror opportunity.
uncertainty: Kernel and hardware dependence, eager-vs-fused query transform, RoPE position provenance, model training variance. Report CPU and GPU separately, seeds=5.
stopping: Stop after 3 dev seeds then 5 fresh worlds; if cheap mechanism fails predeclared gate, record negative and do not tune fresh. Hardware unavailable => BLOCKED (not PASS).
prior_art_delta: Compress multiple GVA head-specific M_h maps with small Mirror codes and quantify incremental gain beyond native GVA; query-side absorption itself belongs to GVA.
limitations: GVA's query absorption and value caching are established prior art; Mirror claim is only the marginal head-map parameterization.

uncertainty_model.observable: Quality Q in its declared units (nat/token or dimensionless error), task/seed paired samples
uncertainty_model.combined_standard: u_c=sqrt(u_seed^2+u_eval^2+u_num^2) for independent components; include covariance otherwise
uncertainty_model.expanded: U=k_cov*u_c; only indicative with 5 worlds, bootstrap interval primary
uncertainty_model.storage: actual byte count is exact for fixed serialization
uncertainty_model.sequential_stop: perform all five frozen fresh worlds, do not early-stop for favorable result or tune on audit data
